mapper.select: SELECT i.* , c.title AS collection_title , c.emoji , u.nickname AS created_by_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_members m WHERE m.collection_id = i.collection_id) AS member_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = i.collection_id) AS place_count FROM invites i JOIN collections c ON c.collection_id = i.collection_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by WHERE i.invite_code = #{inviteCode}
SELECT i.* , u.nickname AS created_by_nickname FROM invites i JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by WHERE i.collection_id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT i.invite_id , i.invite_code , i.role , i.collection_id , c.title AS collection_title , c.emoji , u.nickname AS created_by_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_members m WHERE m.collection_id = i.collection_id) AS member_count FROM pending_invites pi JOIN invites i ON i.invite_id = pi.invite_id JOIN collections c ON c.collection_id = i.collection_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by WHERE pi.user_id = #{userId} AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND (i.expires_at IS NULL OR i.expires_at > NOW()) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_members m2 WHERE m2.collection_id = i.collection_id AND m2.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY pi.created_at DESC
